question: Approve the ideation direction: merge guard refuses a passed finalize unless a committed stage-report commit strictly precedes the first terminal-state commit in the entity's own history?

artifacts.summary: Ideation settled the open sub-shape from both failing runs' retained streams: both end batched in durable history, reached two ways — run 32092321763's workers hand-flipped status=done and committed flip plus report together; run 32105482382's worker never committed and the guard's archive commit swept the dirty report in. One ceremony-time ordering check covers both. Design walks the entity's own git history with the package's existing helpers, refusing exit 1 with nothing mutated, before the mod-block clear. Exemptions: rejected verdict, --rework, non-git root. Spiked red and green against four replayed shapes and six real archived histories (all pass). Net +260 across up to 12 files, mostly fixture fallout. Note: issue #689 lands in the same finalize().
